title: A BiocParallelParam class using Futures
text: future package provides generic API using futures R. future simple yet powerful mechanism evaluate R expression retrieve value point time. Futures can resolved many different ways depending strategy used. various types synchronous asynchronous futures choose future package. Additional futures implemented packages. instance, future.batchtools package provides futures type backend batchtools package supports. introduction futures R, please consult vignettes future package. BiocParallel.FutureParam package provides FutureParam, BiocParallelParam class, BiocParallel package works type future. BiocParallel.FutureParam package cross platform just future package. example showing use FutureParam multicore futures. multicore future evaluated parallel using forked workers, supported MS Windows fall back sequential processing.
code: library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) plan(multicore)  mu <- 1.0 sigma <- 2.0 x <- bplapply(1:3, mu = mu, sigma = sigma, function(i, mu, sigma) {   rnorm(i, mean = mu, sd = sigma) })

title: A BiocParallelParam class using Futures
text: Due generic nature futures, FutureParam class provides functionality many existing BiocParallelParam classes, e.g. SerialParam, SnowParam, MulticoreParam, BatchtoolsParam DoparParam. addition, provides supports additional backends yet implemented BiocParallel, e.g. callr batchtools.
code: library("BiocParallel") register(SerialParam()) library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) plan(sequential) library("BiocParallel") register(MulticoreParam()) library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) plan(multicore) library("BiocParallel") register(SnowParam(2, type = "SOCK")) library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) plan(multisession, workers = 2) library("BiocParallel") cl <- parallel::makeCluster(2, type = "SOCK") register(as(cl, "SnowParam")) library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) cl <- parallel::makeCluster(2, type = "SOCK") plan(cluster, workers = cl) library("BiocParallel") register(SnowParam(4, type = "MPI")) library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) cl <- parallel::makeCluster(4, type = "MPI") plan(cluster, workers = cl) library("BiocParallel") register(BatchtoolsParam(cluster="sge",                          template="~/sge.tmpl")) library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) plan(future.batchtools::batchtools_sge,      template = "~/sge.tmpl") library("BiocParallel.FutureParam") register(FutureParam()) plan(future.callr::callr)

title: A BiocParallelParam class using Futures

However, report problem, please try doFuture, registerDoFuture(), DoparParam() backend BiocParallel, e.g. works, register(FutureParam()), ’s bug BiocParallel.FutureParam package. Please report https://github.com/HenrikBengtsson/BiocParallel.FutureParam/issues.
code: library("BiocParallel") library("doFuture") register(DoparParam()) ## Tell BiocParallel to use a foreach backend registerDoFuture()     ## Tell foreach to use a future backend plan(multicore)        ## Tell future to use the multicore backend  mu <- 1.0 sigma <- 2.0 x <- bplapply(1:3, mu = mu, sigma = sigma, function(i, mu, sigma) {   rnorm(i, mean = mu, sd = sigma) })
